text-3.865264999bcccf0442548c956b80ca36fdd2265c: Open your own spa or visit a friend’s spa to give your T4 Tatari stat bonuses and daily Sparkle progress. Upgrade an active spa through four levels to improve its buffs. Two special effects rotate weekly for newly opened spas.

text-5.e217a7022aab48e6a8a81247c59d7b27b04d68f5: Sandy Maze Goldrush MVP rewards give 180, 150, 120 or 100 Spa Soap for league ranks I–IV. Check the in-game shop for other available sources.

text-8.d8edfd3679e3c8d4ee79b0d44164e8f726fa73d0: Gain 50 Sparkle progress at daily settlement at every spa level.

text-17.74f29a956ea5a60b38628e6e0e63a6bce183151b: Increase ATK for the host and guests.

text-18.4f2cc454af147f5b74de7e1ab727c0bbc770ab0c: Increase HP for the host and guests.

text-19.4abddfd2b3cfed34e65adbfca3402b3aefd7f6b1: Increase DEF for the host and guests.

text-9.3e9a14d4a0b4357738f0db997b373f106d956a1e: Double the chance of becoming Glitter when feeding Glitter Fruit. This is not a guaranteed Glitter result.

text-10.7789bc1dc7d8ddf9b443e81abf5d5702a245ae1c: An 80% chance of double feeding progress. The daily trigger limit rises at Level 3.

text-13.2f9fc2282d8d3a02667a649bd05b89679171a853: Double-output chance at the Bento Maker rises from 80% to 100% at Level 3.

text-15.d864cf5c78b4c772b3ec31d44041e7ba2a16bbc5: Reduce Energy Drink costs in Goldrush.

text-7.255fa87488953e73ab6ee136a1fb2b987ac53f90: Every newly opened spa has fixed ATK, HP, DEF and Sparkle progress buffs, plus the current pair of weekly specials. Expand each effect to compare all four levels. Daily limits are shared across spas and upgrades.

text-23.aff9544346128732e68b81127f53e66d7c89de59: Host your own spa. Open it with Spa Soap, then upgrade it while active. The special-buff pair is locked when you open it and stays the same until it expires, including across a weekly rotation.

text-24.d866f3001392a6a9ef6e6cc3ce1161d71cbf1cc0: Choose a friend’s spa. The Spa Station shows available buffs, spa level and time remaining. Guests share the owner’s special-buff pair and benefit from upgrades immediately. Your Tatari can use only one spa at a time.

text-25.d3612f11bc12a91a55ae449d226853cad0f2e439: Friends can enter directly when the owner enables free joining. Otherwise, request approval. Leaving, being removed or expiry ends the active benefits. Switching spas and upgrading do not reset daily trigger counts.

text-27.e888b4f8a84025cca0c41fb764f370a7e4a7ed41: The weekly special pair follows the UTC calendar using the game’s server time. Opening a spa locks that pair for its entire session; upgrading changes its strength, not its combination. A rotation affects newly opened spas only.

note-6.3348ccdad39ee494ccf7260f5c8a522ceefdfbfb: This is the opening schedule, not a live reading of your account. An existing spa can still have the previous pair. Check the in-game opening preview before spending Soap.
note-6.ec42f5174d1c8675533f10606807fda98a7a7853: This is the opening schedule, not a live reading of your account. An existing spa can still have the previous pair. Check the in-game opening preview before spending Soap.

text-31.86732d8cf3747555ebed3123e96d58b155258a22: Choose a Tatari family to see its five Standard and two Rare T4 appearances. New additions: Pyrodaemon, Sealord, Boltallion, Cribking and Morphanessa.

list-6.e76c47e4c2cfef8cfb753c8a381ec12c8c90ff8c: Upgrade early. Upgrades improve the remaining session without extending it; the level resets when you open again.
